name: playgama
description: Publish HTML5 games on Playgama from your agent: upload builds and covers, fill in the form, get a playable link and see how players do.
suggestedPrompts: Publish this game to Playgama and give me a public link I can share.
Upload the new build of my game and tell me when the analysis is done.
Show the moderation comments on my game and fix the form.
